What size power station for a 12V fridge?

Refrigeration Also called: 12v fridge, portable fridge, camping fridge

Two numbers decide whether a power station runs a 12V portable fridge/freezer, and readers arrive using them interchangeably. Watts are the ceiling on what the inverter can hold at any instant — this load needs 90 W of them while it runs, and 180 W for the moment it starts. Watt-hours are how much energy the battery holds, and this load gets through about 222 Wh in a day. A machine can have plenty of one and not enough of the other.

Of the 26 station records we publish — every model we hold a page for, with its US and EU versions counted separately — 26 run it, 0 are a tight fit and 0 are out of reach. Each of those is a calculation against that machine’s continuous output, its surge ceiling and its inverter waveform — not a lookup table — and the reasoning is on every row.

The three numbers a power station is judged against

Running power 90 W 78–125 W Official spec · verified 2026-08-01 · high confidence
Start-up surge 180 W engine checks 180 W Derived from official coefficients · verified 2026-08-01 · medium confidence
Duty cycle Not found in the sources we checked no figure to date

The band is the spread across real models in this class, not a tolerance. Size against the top of it unless you know which unit you own.

Start-up figure: Manufacturer-stated

The start-up figure is published by the manufacturer for this device, so it describes the actual hardware rather than a category.

This record publishes both an absolute inrush and a multiple of running power. They do not agree exactly, so the engine checks against the more demanding of the two — 180 W — rather than picking the flattering one.

Official spec + Derived from official coefficients · verified 2026-08-08 · appliance record

What actually decides it

A variable-speed motor: it ramps instead of slamming

This compressor is fed by its own electronics, which start it gently and then modulate its speed to the work in front of it. The start-up peak is small or absent, and the running draw is a band rather than a point — low most of the time, climbing only under load. The binding constraint is usually the top of that band, not the start.

What kind of motor is inside

The motor is brushless and driven by its own inverter board, which is why the start-up demand is modest: the electronics ramp the motor rather than connecting it straight to the line.

Questions people ask about this load

How many watts does a 12V portable fridge/freezer use?
90 W while it is running, and 78–125 W across the models in this class, with 180 W demanded at the instant it starts. Those are different questions and most pages answer only the first. The running figure decides whether a machine can hold it; the start-up figure decides whether it can get it going at all, and it is usually the one that fails. The start-up figure here is the manufacturer’s own..
What size power station do I need for a 12V portable fridge/freezer?
For a 12V portable fridge/freezer, the BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 (US 120 V) is the cheapest machine in our library that runs it, at 600 W continuous and $299 against a running draw of 90 W and a start-up demand of 180 W. That is a verdict computed from this load’s running watts, its start-up demand and the inverter waveform — not a rule of thumb about doubling the wattage. 26 of 26 machines clear it.
How long will a power station run a 12V portable fridge/freezer?
No machine in our library can answer that honestly yet, and none of the 26 rows above pretends otherwise. A runtime needs a usable-capacity figure; for the machines that reach a 12V portable fridge/freezer the brands publish a nameplate watt-hour rating and nothing about depth of discharge or inverter efficiency. Dividing that nameplate by this load would give a confident-looking figure that is typically 20–35% too high. Every row gives the energy rate instead — watt-hours per hour — which needs no battery figure at all.
Why does a 12V portable fridge/freezer need so much more power to start?
The start-up figure is published by the manufacturer for this device, so it describes the actual hardware rather than a category. The engine works the check against 180 W, which is what a station's surge ceiling has to cover for the moment the machine starts. A station whose continuous rating is comfortably above the running figure can still refuse the start, and that is the single most common way a purchase goes wrong for this class.
Which power stations run a 12V portable fridge/freezer?
26 of the 26 we hold, listed above cheapest-first within each verdict band, starting with the BLUETTI Elite 30 V2. All 26 of them run a 12V portable fridge/freezer. Every one of those is a live calculation against that machine's own record, and opening a row shows the working.
